I was big into horses when I was little girl, then around 9 I found a lizard and everything changed. I couldn't get enough of reptiles and the idea of dragons was mind blowing! Dragon was the only choice for me :)

As for design I flip flopped over designs for literally years. Then an artist I like was selling off designs (before the adopt craze took hold) and I fell in love. She's been tweaked a bit over the years but my grey dragoness will always be me <3

My character is a fennec fox for a few reasons:

  • I've always had pretty good hearing. I've been able to hear a dog barking outside of my friend's house over a Skype call even when he couldn't hear it, I've heard my friends' phones vibrating in their pockets in busy college environments, I've also heard a smoke detector beeping at the other end of my parent's house, through about 3-4 walls and a few doors. Those are just the few examples I remember.
  • I always walk super fast and constantly leave my friends behind accidentally. If you've seen a video of a fennec, you'd know how speedy they are.
  • Their big 'ol ears are adorable, I find them cute.

For the bonus question:

  • The name: When I was creating the name, I wanted it to represent me. Since I was majoring in Computer Science as a programmer and was minoring in Art, I decided to go with the name Art and Logic => A and L => A x L => Axel. For the surname, I decided to start it with "Spark" because I really like electronic music, and slapped on "ster" at the end to make "Axel Sparkster" because "Axel Spark" sounded way too bland. Funny enough, a character named "Sparkster" already existed, but I didn't know about him at all. But yeah, I don't tell this to many people about how I came up with this because I think it's lame lol
  • The character itself: My character didn't always used to be a fennec fox, it used to be a Siamese/Fennec hybrid. Eventually, I decided that the design wasn't as pleasing as I would have liked, so I decided to cut out the Siamese part. I also got rid of some of the usual fennec markings to simplify the design a bit more. For the hair I decided to go with something peppy but cute so I gave him this.
  • The logo: The character logo is a wheel overlaid by a spark. The spark comes from "Sparkster" and the circle comes from the word "Axle" (which sounds like "Axel"). I also have some interest in astronomy so it also kinda looks like a planet and a star.
  • The costume design: The costume is a sailor outfit because I've always found sailor outfits cute. It was also inspired by outfits I've seen in Kpop videos (another music genre I like). I kept the dress shirt unbuttoned to kind of accentuate my more casual personality and also put the logo on the hat and undershirt for stylistic purposes.
